paper.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
truncated_sections: B.5 Performance Variance and Pass@k Rate

result.summary: 本文研究界面设计如何影响语言模型智能体在软件工程任务上的表现，并提出 SWE-agent 系统，让 LM 智能体通过专门设计的 agent-computer interface（ACI）自主使用计算机解决软件工程问题 [abstract][S1.p3]。SWE-agent 的 ACI 提供查看、搜索和编辑文件的少量简单动作，并配有防止常见错误的护栏和简洁反馈 [S1.p3]。在 SWE-bench 和 HumanEvalFix 上，SWE-agent 分别取得 12.5% 和 87.7% 的 pass@1 成绩，超过此前非交互式 LM 的最好结果 [abstract]。作者还通过消融研究分析 ACI 设计选择，并指出精心设计的 ACI 能在不修改底层 LM 权重的情况下显著提升智能体表现 [S1.p4][S1.p5]。

research_question.text: 本文要解决的问题是：界面设计如何影响语言模型智能体的性能，以及如何为 LM 智能体设计专门的计算机接口以完成软件工程任务 [abstract][S1.p3]。作者认为，正如人类从 IDE 等软件应用中受益，LM 智能体代表一类有自身需求和能力的新型终端用户，也会受益于专门构建的软件接口 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: We investigate how interface design affects the performance of language model agents.
we posit that LM agents represent a new category of end users with their own needs and abilities, and would benefit from specially-built interfaces to the software they use.
We show that ACIs tailored specifically for LMs outperform existing user interfaces (UIs) designed for human users, such as the Linux shell.

method.text: 论文提出 SWE-agent，一个由 LM 和 ACI 组成的智能体，可与计算机交互解决具有挑战性的真实软件工程问题 [S1.p3]。其 ACI 基于 Linux shell 构建，提供查看、搜索和编辑文件的少量简单动作，使用护栏防止常见错误，并在每一步向智能体提供关于命令效果的具体简洁反馈 [S1.p3]。ACI 包含搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理等主要组件，智能体每步生成一个想法和命令，然后纳入环境执行反馈 [S3.p1]。作者假设固定 LM，专注于设计 ACI，通过人工检查智能体行为识别困难并提出改进，以及网格搜索选择最佳 ACI 配置 [S2.p4]。

evidence.quote: we introduce SWE-agent, an agent composed of an LM and ACI, that can interact with a computer to solve challenging real-world software engineering problems
SWE-agent’s ACI instead offers a small set of simple actions for viewing, searching through and editing files.
The ACI uses guardrails to prevent common mistakes, and an agent receives specific, concise feedback about a command’s effects at every turn.
The ACI comprises several principal components, including search/navigation, file viewer, file editor, and context management.
At each step, SWE-agent generates a thought and a command, then incorporates the feedback from the command’s execution in the environment
we assume a fixed LM and focus on designing the ACI to improve its performance

We use two approaches to enhance performance on a development set: (1) manually inspect agent behavior to identify difficulties and propose improvements, and (2) run a grid search to select the best ACI configuration.

experiments.text: 论文主要在 SWE-bench 数据集上评估，该数据集包含来自 12 个流行 Python 包仓库的 2,294 个任务实例 [S4.p1]。主要智能体结果在完整 SWE-bench 测试集上报告，消融和分析在 SWE-bench Lite 测试集上进行，后者是包含 300 个实例的规范子集，聚焦自包含功能缺陷修复 [S4.p1]。作者还用 HumanEvalFix 测试 SWE-agent 的基本代码编辑能力 [S4.p1]。在 SWE-bench、Basic CLI 和 RAG 设置下对模型进行基准测试 [S4.T3]。

evidence.quote: We primarily evaluate on the SWE-bench dataset, which includes $2,294$ task instances from $12$ different repositories of popular Python packages.
We report our main agent results on the full SWE-bench test set and ablations and analysis on the SWE-bench Lite test set, unless otherwise specified.
SWE-bench Lite is a canonical subset of $300$ instances from SWE-bench that focus on evaluating self-contained functional bug fixes.
We also test SWE-agent’s basic code editing abilities with HumanEvalFix, a short-form code debugging benchmark.
We benchmark models in the SWE-agent, Basic CLI, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) settings established in SWE-bench.

findings.text: 使用 GPT-4 Turbo 作为基础 LM，SWE-agent 解决了 2,294 个 SWE-bench 测试任务中的 12.47%，大幅超过此前非交互式检索增强系统 3.8% 的最好解决率 [S1.p4]。在 300 个 SWE-bench Lite 实例上的消融研究显示，SWE-agent 比仅使用默认 Linux shell 的基线智能体多解决 10.7 个百分点 [S1.p4]。ACI 可移植到不同 LM：SWE-agent 搭配 Claude 3 Opus 可解决 10.5% 的基准任务 [S1.p4]。在 SWE-bench 和 HumanEvalFix 上，SWE-agent 分别取得 12.5% 和 87.7% 的 pass@1 率，达到当时最优 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: Using GPT-4 Turbo as a base LM, SWE-agent solves $12.47$ % of the $2,294$ SWE-bench test tasks, substantially outperforming the previous best resolve rate of $3.8$ % by a non-interactive, retrieval-augmented system.
The results show that SWE-agent solves $10.7$ percentage points more instances than the baseline agent, which uses only the default Linux shell.
SWE-agent with Claude 3 Opus can solve $10.5$ % of the benchmark tasks.
We evaluate SWE-agent on SWE-bench and HumanEvalFix, achieving state-of-the-art performance on both with a pass@ 1 1 rate of 12.5 12.5 % and 87.7 87.7 %, respectively
